note: Ground-truth evaluation settings for robot_vision/gt_path.py (evaluation code only; never read by inference code). Declared 2026-10-23 before any v4 run.
optimal_length_note: Python's A* length must equal Unity's optimal_path.json length within this absolute tolerance (same grid, same step costs, so only float rounding is allowed).
near_optimal_note: A trail point counts as near the optimal path when it is within this many grid cells (cell_size_m each) of the optimal polyline (docs/project_flow_v4.md: share of the trail within one grid cell).
leak_note: Leak test: ground-truth layer on and off must render identical images (0 = every pixel equal, so the images must be lossless, e.g. PNG).
